summary: stress suite had no coverage of the v0.2 signing path
root_cause: stress scenarios were designed in the v0.1 hardening phase; the signing module landed later and nobody re-derived stress coverage from the delta
detection: manual live re-run before answering an owner audit question ('did you stress test v0.2?')
fix: scenario g added: 10k seal_sign/seal_verify throughput + 500-entry strict S6 verification; 7/7 OK
lesson: every feature delta needs a test-delta review, stress included; old green does not cover new code
